name: edutrack-ai-v2
description: EduTrack AI v2 - Sistema de Gestão Acadêmica, Previsão Estatística e Recomendações com IA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,ANALYTICS,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:analytics" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../analytics-service && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:analytics
